scope: Read-only SHA-256 preservation checks for the current mobile menu validation. Original settings, user-supplied music and earlier APKs stayed unchanged; actual user saves are checked separately from generated test artifacts.

validationBaselineClassification.classification: The unchanged baseline included one Unity TestRunner temporary scene metadata file. Its exact path and hash identify the single expected cleanup; the missing-file observation remains in the full local report. Permanent files are the other 1221 entries.

persistentTree.classification: TestResults.xml and StorageTests/** are generated test artifacts. Changes in those categories are counted separately and do not mean actual player save/settings files changed.

limitations: This summary intentionally omits absolute paths, home-directory names, individual fixture paths and per-file lists. Detailed evidence remains in the local report.

Protected counts describe the supplied permanent-file baselines and the 35 selected source/meta pairs; the separately reported temporary TestRunner metadata cleanup is not counted as a preserved permanent file. This is not a claim that every workspace file is unchanged.
Generated test artifacts may change, so the whole persistent directory is only unchanged when wholeTreeUnchanged is true.
The music exclusion check describes the current validation Assets tree; it does not remove or assess music in earlier remote history.
This preservation check does not execute Unity tests, install an APK, verify real-device gameplay or publish a build.
